stem: What is the default view of a Word 2013 document?
explanation: It shows the document as it will print.
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: Which tab contains the tools for mail merge?
explanation: Mail merge sends one letter to many people.
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: Which Home tab tool copies the formatting of one paragraph to another?
explanation: It is in the Clipboard group.

stem: Which tab is used to insert a watermark such as "Confidential"?
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: Mark as Final is a security feature that the recipient cannot undo.
explanation: The recipient can remove it; it only signals a completed work.
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: The Quick Access Toolbar stays the same whichever tab is open.
explanation: By default it has Save, Undo and Redo.
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: Which are the three basic components of the Ribbon?
explanation: Templates appear on the Start Screen.
source: CSC 272 lecture Notes.pdf (Dr N. C. Woods)

stem: Which is not a view in Microsoft Word 2013?
explanation: Slide Sorter is a PowerPoint view.
